title: Does not work as advertised
text:
Does not work as advertised. Unable to use all the features as the buttons don't work. Unable to change temperature settings. Stays at 370.
The open/close button does not work. Had high hopes for this but not worth the headache.

Enjoy Healthier Food: Air frying requires no or less oil. Produce well-cooked food without the guilt of using unhealthy oil and consuming cholesterol. Perfect health and fitness enthusiast
